title: !  Auto Guess Auto Sumbit + More
features:
- Auto Color automatically selects the correct character color
- Auto Submit automatically submits the selected color
- Human Delay adds a randomized delay before submitting
- Missing Hunt detects unsupported characters and learns their correct colors after reveal
- Automatically saves learned character colors
- Supported / Missing character list
- Session Stats for rounds, submissions, learned characters, and missing characters found
- Automatically detects newly added characters
- Mobile and PC support
- Touch-friendly interface with large buttons
- Draggable GUI
- Minimize and reopen button
Discord: @87eu

changelog.message: add mobile-friendly auto color, missing hunt, human delay, session stats
